meaning: After an arrest, a detention, a last-seen account or a missing report, a silence longer than this many days until the next dated record is offered.
A routine needs at least this many distinct days on which one source, or records of one place, name the person.
Those days must run over at least this many days, so a short burst is not a routine.
A routine's silence is offered only when it is longer than this many days.
and longer than this many times the person's own usual interval between those days.
